description: Réseaux structurants eaux usées sur Rennes Métropole is a dataset listed in Rennes-metropole open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Rennes Métropole. Cette couche matérialise de façon schématique l'écoulement des réseaux d'eaux usées de Rennes métropole. Coverage: Rennes Métropole. The portal files it under Réseaux, Energie. Its keywords are assainissement urbain, santé publique et assainissement, contrôle d'état, assainissement collectif, rejet d'eaux usées. The portal shows 2,446 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2022-02-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence ODbL 1.0 (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-rennesmetropole-fr-portal.
